layout.heading: Signs Your HMI May *Need Repair*
body: Several warning signs suggest an HMI or display unit needs professional attention before it fails completely. These include unresponsive or drifting touch zones, dim or flickering backlights, intermittent power loss, frozen or corrupted screens on startup, and physical cracks on the front glass. If any of these apply to your equipment, a short call to our repair team, usually under fifteen minutes, is often enough to outline next steps and arrange collection.
